complexity.justification: Radon 6.0.1 counts logical lines through the running Python tokenizer. Measured __init__.py MI parameters on identical source: Python 3.11 LLOC90 versus Python3.12 LLOC91, with identical volume120.40465370320703/CC15/comments54.0. Independently measured per-minor baselines avoid false regressions; unsupported versions and new source files fail closed pending explicit measured review. F2/F4 review (2026-10-30): comprehend adds literal items, vendor confinement and provider panels through extracted helpers (max CC improves 22 to 21); its size-sensitive MI baseline reflects the requested expanded input surface. config_schema adds the shared configured plan-cap threshold policy (max CC 2 to 4); plan_admission owns the common hosting/band policy and residency_gate consumes it, removing the agent_spawn_gate surface import cycle. Only these four files were remeasured on both supported interpreters; all other ratchets remain unchanged. Codex session reaper review (2026-10-30): complete changed bodies reviewed in codex_daemon, codex_exec, delegate_jobs and execution_journal. Durable indexed session capture, additive migration, unreaped pruning protection, active/idle owner leases, existing identity-based liveness, bounded transactional delete/retry and terminal gates add required lifecycle safety; journal wrappers and injected dependencies avoid new import cycles. Existing daemon/journal maximum CC stays 49/23; exec rises 17 to 18 for resume lease cleanup; jobs rises 19 to 30 for the explicit terminal/grace/shared-session/live-owner/error gates. Independently remeasured with Radon 6.0.1 under Python 3.11 and 3.12; only these four file baselines changed.

The added schema and settlement checks retain maximum CC 69; the size-sensitive calls.py MI is independently measured with Radon 6.0.1 on Python 3.11 and 3.12. Only this file's two measured MI baselines change; cyclic-edge, dead-code, duplication and all other complexity limits are unchanged. Snapshot identity, pending bulk and failure tests plus structural bypass mutations enforce the contracts.

complexity.reviewed_daily_rollup: 2026-10-30: Reviewed complete daily rollup bodies: additive disposable memo/dirty-day schema, exact shared nano expressions, bounded transactional dirty markers, revision compare-and-clear, snapshot overlays, optimistic publication, reporting-day rollover, heap fallback and off-hot-path snapshot audits. Dependency-injected snapshot/money contracts avoid new cyclic edges. Audit persists mismatch markers before publication and forces heap if marker persistence is refused. Required dirty-day and audit behavior expands the module; only this new module and the two-line WAL maintenance admission wiring receive independently measured Radon 6.0.1 baselines under Python 3.11 and 3.12. Existing cycle, duplication, dead-code and other file complexity ratchets remain unchanged. Regression groups verify precision, corruption, concurrent writes, snapshots and cadence.
complexity.reviewed_delegate_cancel_orphan_group_re: Records the measured cost of the new stdlib-only bounded process-group reaper and the cancel-path orphaned-group reap and identity logic.

The added conditional is the fix itself (reviewed in PR #277, axis-4 delegate cancel-retention); the measured CC/MI shift is recorded here rather than refactored away because collapsing the guard would reintroduce the dangling-metadata defect.

Concurrent actual-router and detached success/cancel tests exercise primary-checkout confinement, cleanup and retained inspection; bypassing isolation makes targeting tests red. subscription_cli_results extracts existing fixed-shape provider decoding and warm fallback contracts with injected transports, preserving errors and usage without package imports or semantic routing decisions. Provider execution targeting tests and read-only-routing mutations cover its consumers. Exact Radon 6.0.1 new-file measurements independently match on Python 3.11 and 3.12; existing file ratchets and cyclic-edge limits are unchanged.

Targeting lifetime, cancellation, wait, stream and warm tests include mutation proofs.

Independently remeasured with Radon 6.0.1 under Python 3.11 and 3.12; only capability_readiness_gates.py's baseline changes, identically on each interpreter. complexity.reviewed_ledger_read_expiry_debug_demote:
Promoting the self-healing managed-read-expiry deferral log line to a module-level SSOT message
constant (MANAGED_READ_EXPIRY_DEFERRED_LOG_MESSAGE) and demoting it from WARNING to DEBUG marginally
lowers this file's maintainability index (max CC unchanged at 34; MI 29.6357 -> 29.5825). The demote
is a deliberate, reviewed observability change: the deferral is routine under connection-step-lock
contention and self-healing (the background expiry sweep re-schedules; outcome flag
MANAGED_READ_CLEANUP_DEFERRED), so DEBUG is the correct level. It stops production WARNING log spam and
benign leakage into tests that assert logger silence, while hiding no terminal error (raised
LedgerQueryDeadline/LedgerReadTimeout paths are unchanged and still surface). The SSOT constant removes
a duplicated string literal so the one observability assertion can import it rather than re-hardcode it.
Reviewed and accepted as part of closing the busy-connection / ledger-read-expiry timing flake family.

dead_confidence_justification: Vulture defines 100% findings as definite unused arguments/variables and unreachable code. Lower-confidence unused public functions and attributes require caller/dynamic-registration review and are explicitly tracked separately; this gate does not claim full dead-code absence.
duplication_justification: Use pylint symilar's documented default minimum of four significant lines; comments, docstrings, imports and function signatures are declarations rather than implementation duplication. Compare every source file against every other source file. Ratchet lines and groups to measured current values.

layer_contract.reason: These actual foundation modules own immutable parser data, pure deadline cadence, and launchd label constants; each currently depends only on the standard library. Prevent application/surface imports into these foundations. Broader core/surface separation is not claimed: config and pricing currently import adapters/calls.
